checks.coverage: All 65536 previous/current byte pairs, repeated levels, alternating patterns, and output stability between rising edges

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; no official feedback was accessed.
No reset or defined power-up state is specified. RTL registers remain uninitialized until clocked; the testbench establishes zero input history before checking transitions.
No synthesis or board verification was performed.
implementation: At each rising edge, register in AND NOT the previous sampled input, then update the previous sample using nonblocking assignments. Ports and widths match the original specification, with no reset or extra pipeline stage.
static_review: Single sequential driver, explicit 8-bit history and output, nonblocking assignments, no extra ports, no reset, no latches.
